analysis: Price is probing above the Value Area High at 77,750, but the move is disproportionately driven by perpetual futures leverage rather than spot demand. This heavy negative spot-perp CVD divergence leaves the breakout vulnerable to long exhaustion and a rapid mean reversion back into the value area.
key_risk: Lack of spot volume follow-through triggering a cascade of leveraged long liquidations below 77,750 VAH.
